name: Karasuma Rito
source:
Birthplace: Kyoto
Special skills: Acting, reading
Hobbies: Reading
Favorite food: Meat buns

Member of Kanto's project 47's "Team Smile" who is ranked 43rd between all of the project 47's idols. Despite her rank, she is the lead star of a popular late-night drama and her idol activities are on a good track. Rito has a mature and relaxed personality, and she is fond of her best friend, teammate and crush, [url=/c53935]Ayaka[/url], whom she is always shown to be hanging around with.
